input.command: git remote -v && git branch -a && git log --oneline -15 && git rev-parse HEAD && git merge-base HEAD origin/splitter/1108004416/r1/A 2>/dev/null; ls -la artifacts
mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && node smoke.ts | tee /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log && node scratch/check.ts | tee /opt/cursor/artifacts/local-price-check.log

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Charge usdCents × today's major-unit rate, then round half away from zero into minor units (yen ×1, everything else ×100). I left the old 2% euro fee off, because "until now" describes the manual workaround and the acceptance criteria only require today's rate. I also left charm and whole-unit snapping off: the ticket never names an ending, and coarser rounding can zero out or reprice small amounts.

<risk>
A reviewer who treats the euro note as a live 2% markup, or who reads "look clean" as nearest whole euro/pound or a .99 ending, will expect different amounts. The half-unit tolerance can also lift a value that sits within about 16 ulps under n.5.

<verified>
`node scratch/check.ts` passed every case, including the 100.5-cent float boundary, yen with no ×100, and a euro price with no 2% fee. `node smoke.ts` loads `localPrice`; its neutral fixture has no `usdCents` or `rate`, so that call returns NaN and does not exercise the rules.
EOF
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git push -u origin HEAD
